newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares follow European drop.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares follow European drop.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Portuguese shares dropped in line with losses across Europe but the market did not fall as steeply as Madrid.
*PSI20 index .PSI20 was off 116.31 points, or 1.47 pct, at 7,777.30.
*PSI20 July futures were down 116 points at 7,770.
*"It's very panicky since Madrid and Paris have fallen so sharply. I think we'll see further losses before the close," said one trader.
*EDP was off 38 escudos at 3,242 on volume of 688,854.
*Portucel was the only share that bucked the trend, adding 13 esc to 1,496 with 358,530 shares traded in anticipation of strong half-year results which were due to be announced at 1530 GMT.
